newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sears Q2 EPS view trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sears Q2 EPS view trimmed.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said Monday it cut its second-quarter earnings estimate for retailer Sears, Roebuck & Co to $0.74 a share from $0.76.
-- The fiscal 1997 estimate is now $3.58 a share, down from $3.60 previously. In a report, Dillon, Read cited lower than expected sales in April and May as the reason for the earnings estimate cut.

-- "Sears full-line stores continue to generate solid growth in softlines led by double-digit sales increases in women's ready-to-wear, footwear, fine jewelry, cosmetics and fragrances," Dillon, Read said. "Net sales have been negatively affected by a drop in hardline sales. Unseasonably cool weather in much of the country delayed the sales of air conditioners, riding mowers and tractors, and other seasonal product lines which altered overall domestic store results."
-- But it added that, in regions not affected by cool weather such as the Northwest and Southwset, overall sales were strong.

-- Dillon, Read also said comparable-store sales during the second quarter have been difficult to beat as warm weather arrived much earlier last year. The 1996 second quarter same-store sales were up 9.4 percent, compared with Dillon, Read's estimate for this quarter of a gain of three percent.
